queries.text: विक्रेता 1 ने कितने ऑर्डर प्राप्त किए हैं?
queries.english_equivalent: How many orders has Seller Store 1 received?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN sellers s ON o.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE s.display_name_local = 'विक्रेता 1'
queries.notes: Devanagari seller name must survive into a display_name_local match, not translated to display_name.

queries.text: विक्रेता 2 ने कितने ऑर्डर प्राप्त किए हैं?
queries.english_equivalent: How many orders has Seller Store 2 received?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN sellers s ON o.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE s.display_name_local = 'विक्रेता 2'
queries.notes: Devanagari seller name must survive into a display_name_local match, not translated to display_name.

queries.text: विक्रेता 3 के ऑर्डर का कुल मूल्य कितना है?
queries.english_equivalent: What is the total order value for Seller Store 3?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(o.order_value) FROM orders o JOIN sellers s ON o.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE s.display_name_local = 'विक्रेता 3'

queries.text: विक्रेता 4 के ऑर्डर का कुल मूल्य कितना है?
queries.english_equivalent: What is the total order value for Seller Store 4?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(o.order_value) FROM orders o JOIN sellers s ON o.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE s.display_name_local = 'विक्रेता 4'

queries.text: विक्रेता 6 की श्रेणी क्या है?
queries.english_equivalent: What category is Seller Store 6 in?

queries.text: विक्रेता 7 के लिए कितने विवाद दर्ज हुए हैं?
queries.english_equivalent: How many disputes have been raised for Seller Store 7?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disputes d JOIN orders o ON d.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sellers s ON o.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE s.display_name_local = 'विक्रेता 7'

queries.text: विक्रेता 8 के लिए कितने विवाद दर्ज हुए हैं?
queries.english_equivalent: How many disputes have been raised for Seller Store 8?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disputes d JOIN orders o ON d.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sellers s ON o.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE s.display_name_local = 'विक्रेता 8'

queries.english_equivalent: What is Seller Store 1's contracted SLA in hours?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT contracted_sla_hours FROM sellers WHERE display_name_local = 'विक्रेता 1'

queries.text: विक्रेता 3 की अनुबंधित SLA कितने घंटे की है?
queries.english_equivalent: What is Seller Store 3's contracted SLA in hours?

queries.text: मुंबई में कितने ऑर्डर डिलीवर हुए हैं?
queries.english_equivalent: How many orders have been delivered to Mumbai?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN locations l ON o.ship_to_location_id = l.location_id JOIN fulfillments f ON f.order_id = o.order_id WHERE l.city_local = 'मुंबई' AND f.status = 'delivered'

queries.text: दिल्ली में कितने ऑर्डर डिलीवर हुए हैं?
queries.english_equivalent: How many orders have been delivered to Delhi?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN locations l ON o.ship_to_location_id = l.location_id JOIN fulfillments f ON f.order_id = o.order_id WHERE l.city_local = 'दिल्ली' AND f.status = 'delivered'

queries.text: बेंगलुरु में कितने विक्रेता स्थित हैं?
queries.english_equivalent: How many sellers are located in Bengaluru?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sellers s JOIN locations l ON s.location_id = l.location_id WHERE l.city_local = 'बेंगलुरु'

queries.text: चेन्नई में कितने विक्रेता स्थित हैं?
queries.english_equivalent: How many sellers are located in Chennai?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sellers s JOIN locations l ON s.location_id = l.location_id WHERE l.city_local = 'चेन्नई'

queries.text: हैदराबाद के ऑर्डर के लिए औसत डिलीवरी देरी कितने घंटे की है?
queries.english_equivalent: What is the average delivery delay in hours for orders to Hyderabad?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.delivered_at - f.promised_at)) / 3600) FROM fulfillments f JOIN orders o ON f.order_id = o.order_id JOIN locations l ON o.ship_to_location_id = l.location_id WHERE l.city_local = 'हैदराबाद' AND f.delivered_at IS NOT NULL

queries.text: पुणे के ऑर्डर के लिए औसत डिलीवरी देरी कितने घंटे की है?
queries.english_equivalent: What is the average delivery delay in hours for orders to Pune?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.delivered_at - f.promised_at)) / 3600) FROM fulfillments f JOIN orders o ON f.order_id = o.order_id JOIN locations l ON o.ship_to_location_id = l.location_id WHERE l.city_local = 'पुणे' AND f.delivered_at IS NOT NULL

queries.text: पिछले 30 दिनों में कितने ऑर्डर असफल या वापस हुए हैं?
queries.english_equivalent: How many orders failed or were returned in the last 30 days?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fulfillments WHERE status IN ('failed', 'returned') AND promised_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
queries.notes: Category words (failed/returned) are common nouns, not proper nouns -- translation is expected here.

queries.text: पिछले 60 दिनों में कितने विवाद दर्ज हुए हैं?
